title: upload_blob and download_blob do not set request timeout from ClientConfig
description: blob.rs upload_blob and download_blob build their requests without .timeout(self.config.request_timeout), while fetch_session and call both set it. The inconsistency means blob operations can hang indefinitely. Either apply the timeout (using the existing request_timeout field) or document why blob operations are intentionally timeout-free — the current silence is misleading.
